test_suites.name: Checkout Regression Suite
test_suites.description: Critical checkout, risk decision, and payment regression tests

test_suites.name: Risk Service Resilience Suite
test_suites.description: Timeout, fallback, and circuit breaker tests for the risk decision boundary

test_cases.name: Low-risk order is automatically authorized
test_cases.description: Verify that an order with risk score below threshold receives automatic authorization with decision evidence.

test_cases.name: High-risk order routes to manual review
test_cases.description: Verify that an order with risk score above threshold is refused and routed to manual review with explanation.

test_cases.name: Risk service timeout triggers safe fallback
test_cases.description: Inject 500ms latency into risk service and verify checkout returns safe refusal with structured trace.

test_cases.name: Retry bounded to single attempt with jitter
test_cases.description: Verify that the checkout service retries at most once when the risk service returns 503, with random jitter between 50-100ms.
